blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —The state weather bureau reported that Super Typhoon Rosal (international name: Champi) entered the Philippine area of responsibility (PAR) on Tuesday morning, urging it to raise Tropical Cyclone Wind Signal (TCWS) No. 1 over parts of Northern Luzon and Southern Luzon. Super Typhoon Rosal entered the PAR at 10:40 a.m., according to the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa). READ: Visayas to see isolated rains, thunderstorms as Champi nears PAR In its 11 a.m. weather forecast, Pagasa said that Rosal was last estimated some 1,385 kilometers east of Central Luzon.
